page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8ine.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated Intel Xeon Sapphire Rapids vCPUs operating at a baseline frequency of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a compute-focused allocation of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance type does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. It is equipped with a baseline network bandwidth of 44 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput communication for distributed systems and network-heavy workloads. There are no integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with this configuration.

The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio positions this instance as a compute-optimized resource. It offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads that demand high CPU density and dedicated processing power without the overhead of excess memory. Suitable workloads include high-performance web serving, batch processing, distributed analytics, and compute-intensive application servers.
